Some of the best loot lies below the surface.

- §6Strange Stone§r - a keyhole block hidden deep underground, between Y 6 and 18. It leads to a §cRed Room§r and opens only with a red key.
- §6Library Dungeons§r - small rooms with a mob spawner and books.
- §6Arctic Vaults§r - buried deep under the ground.
- §6Desert Atoms§r - in hot biomes, built around an unexploded bomb, with nuclear loot and rare ores inside.
- §6Ancient Tombs§r - in very hot biomes. Full of radioactive tomb gas, so bring a gas mask.
- §6Enargite Labyrinths§r - in jungles, full of traps, with enargite crates at the end.
- §6Blueprint Caches§r - chests encased in obsidian, spread over the world on a large grid, holding blueprints.
- §6Safes§r - rusty, standard, reinforced and unbreakable, each with better loot than the last. Some are guarded by spiders.
